findings: SNL28 prints twenty MX1 bolt assemblies, each with one 3/4 inch SAE castle nut and one 1/8 x 1.5 inch split pin. It gives no under-head bolt length or head geometry.
SNL96 independently assigns twenty bracket/channel bolt assemblies and twenty MX13 washers. The global SNL267 total24 is consistent with twenty here plus the four existing case-mounted washers.

HB126 photograph shows the bearing castings attached to the transverse channel. Its perspective and hidden upper faces do not uniquely determine the twenty-hole layout. A four-inside/six-outside distribution per bracket is an explicit trial on the unequal pad widths.

Existing Plate22 picks give a5.805714mm inside pad gap. Moving that pad back by8sourcepixels onto the outside pad plane exceeds the original4pixel edge allowance. This is a mechanical-interface hypothesis to be reviewed, not a silent increase of source accuracy.
HB209 twoM391 and standaloneSNL95 twoM391 favor two support feet; nestedSNL42 impliesfour. No foot geometry or quantity disposition is completed by these bracket joints.
HB209 distinguishes twoM389 screwsB and twoM390 screwsC, while SNL205 givesfourM390. These holding screw identities/locations and M386/M387 packer mapping remain unresolved.
